ActiveRights.description_zh: 激活当前账号下的商业版权益。先通过 ListRights 查询权益，再选择目标地域、办公网络、镜像及用户。Success 表示本次请求处理成功，资源创建结果请通过 ListRights 的 RightsActiveStatus、RightsActiveFailureCause 和 RightsResourceId 查询

ListRights.description_en: Queries the commercial edition rights accessible to the current caller identity by using paging. Use this operation to select rights before activation. After you call ActiveRights, you can query the processing results by using RightsActiveStatus, RightsActiveFailureCause, and RightsResourceId
ListRights.description_zh: 分页查询当前调用身份可访问的商业版权益。激活前用于选择权益；调用 ActiveRights 后，通过 RightsActiveStatus、RightsActiveFailureCause 和 RightsResourceId 查询处理结果
